The vCPU-run asm blob does a manual comparison of a VMCS' launched
status to execute the correct VM-Enter instruction
VMRESUME.  The launched flag is a bool
C99 does not define an exact size for _Bool
be large enough to hold '0' and '1'.  Most
a single byte for _Bool
Originally
column2: 'launched' was of type 'int' and so the asm blob used 'cmpl'

column1: to check the launch status.  When 'launched' was moved to be stored on a
per-VMCS basis
in order to avoid having to pass the current VMCS into the asm blob.
The new  '__launched' was defined as a 'bool' and not an 'int'
'cmp' instruction was not updated.
This has not caused any known problems
variables to 4-byte or 8-byte boundaries and KVM zeroing out struct
vcpu_vmx during allocation.  I.e. vCPU-run accesses ""junk"" data
happens to always be zero and so doesn't affect the result.
